verdict.rationale: ELSTER's own business page publishes the cost of its gateway transaction as an explicit amount: registration in Mein ELSTER is stated to be free and one-time ("kostenlose und einmalige Registrierung"), not left to a contact form. Beyond that, the pack shows no published fee statement for the filings themselves, such as the Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung, the tax-number application questionnaire or e-invoice submission. Missing for 10: explicit fee/no-fee statements for each filing transaction, a consolidated statutory fee schedule page, independent corroboration.
